title: Candy
summary: Hand out the fewest candies so every child gets one and anyone rated higher than a neighbour gets more than that neighbour.

tests.explain: Give 1, 2, 1, 2, 1 candies. The child rated 3 beats both neighbours, and the second child rated 2 beats the child rated 1 after it. Two children with equal ratings may get different amounts.
Equal ratings never require more candy, so one candy each is enough.
Every child is rated higher than the one before, so the amounts must climb: 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10.

hints: There are two rules per child: one about the left neighbour and one about the right neighbour. Try satisfying them one direction at a time.
Left to right: if ratings[i] > ratings[i - 1], give child i one more than child i - 1; otherwise 1. Now every left-neighbour rule holds.
Right to left: if ratings[i] > ratings[i + 1], raise child i to at least candies[i + 1] + 1 (take the max, so the left rule stays true). Sum the result.
